scenario: [LNRE.3.1] Under `regex: false` a regex literal is refused "regardless of whether the pattern is ever reached at runtime", because the constraint is on the artefact's content. The match sits behind `false and`, so no evaluation can reach it and a compiler that folded the condition first would drop it silently; it must still be DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. compiler/LDIA.3.4.2_capability_disabled pins a reachable match in `where`; this pins the unreachable one.
rules_ds:
use default:
    regex: false

schema Msg scope logical:
    id: Int key
    text: String mutable

rule r:
    Msg m where false and m.text ~ /alarm/
->
    log info "x"
